title: mixing-weights-known-endmembers: code, numerical results and figures for "Finite-sample risk of maximum likelihood for mixing weights with known components"

creators.name: Pan, Lujia
creators.affiliation: School of Mathematical Sciences, Hebei Normal University

description: Python scripts, seeded numerical outputs, component matrices and figures behind the numerical section (Section 5, Figures 1-3) of the manuscript "Finite-sample risk of maximum likelihood for mixing weights with known components" (L. Pan; manuscript in preparation for submission to the Journal of Multivariate Analysis). Version 1.1.0 adds a strict 1e-8 KKT dual-gap acceptance of every maximum-likelihood replication (all 4,164 grid rows, 8,328,000 replications accepted), the acceptance and independent-check scripts, and machine checks for the current manuscript. Files of the earlier manuscript archived as v1.0.0 are kept unchanged as legacy.
